analogy.rationale: Potassium channel blockers act on ion channels that are largely not transcriptionally coupled to the 978 landmark genes in these cell lines, so responses should be weak; other ion-channel modulators (potassium channel activators, calcium/sodium channel blockers, HCN and ATP channel blockers) share the same channel-centric pharmacology and are expected to produce similarly minimal transcriptional signatures.
